title: Progressive traits and additive numeric fear rewards
description: Keep the six validated progressive trait float changes. Normalize both Intimidating levels to -4 and ROTS Dreaded levels to -1/-2 so every vanilla mod_unit_morale_enemy contribution has a consistent sign. The paired engine adapter preserves the numeric sum in battle instead of replacing it with flat fear. Sword/Mask remain -1, other traits/skills, FOTS and all archive structure remain unchanged.

writes.note: gem_general_dreaded level 1: 1 -> -1; use negative numeric fear, retaining Intimidating magnitude 4
gem_general_dreaded level 2: 2 -> -2; use negative numeric fear, retaining Intimidating magnitude 4
general_intimidating level 1: 1 -> -4; use negative numeric fear, retaining Intimidating magnitude 4
general_intimidating level 2: 1 -> -4; use negative numeric fear, retaining Intimidating magnitude 4
